Broken Floor: A wide gap in the stone floor. Jumping across looks risky.
Cave-in: Piles of rubble block the path. It would take significant effort to clear.
Elemental Barrier: A shimmering wall of energy blocks the way.
Heavy Portcullis: A rusted iron grate blocks the path; it looks like it needs a lever or brute force.
Rope Bridge: A rotted rope bridge spans a lightless chasm. It looks willing to bear your weight - barely.
Glyph-Locked Door: A sealed stone door covered in faintly glowing glyphs. No handle, no keyhole, no hinge.
Wall of Thorns: A dense wall of black thorns blocks the passage; the thorns seem to flinch away from light.
